title: A-Level Physics (9702) Max pack
blurb: Paper technique for definitions, derived quantities, and practical-style reasoning under time.
examinerDigest: Quote the syllabus definition wording for 1-mark definition questions — paraphrase often loses the mark.
Show substitution with units before the final numerical answer; method marks sit in the working.
Link explanations to the physical principle named in the mark scheme, not a vague story.
In graphs and experiments, label axes, gradients, and intercepts explicitly.
